🌟 A NEW OPPORTUNITY AWAITS!

Are you passionate about people and interested in exploring the world of Human Resources?

We're opening an opportunity for HR Intern to join our team!

Gain valuable insights, develop your skills, and experience the exciting world of HR firsthand.

📅 Application Deadline: November 30, 2026

Ready to take the first step? Apply now!
